heard: NASA caught a star swallowing a Jupiter-sized planet. Everyone assumed an aging star expanded and ate its neighbor. Infrared surveys first spotted the flash across our galaxy. Astronomers expected to find a swollen red giant. NASA pointed the James Webb Space Telescope at the star. Spectra proved the host star had not swollen up. Friction dragged the planet inward over time. The planet plunged to its death into an unexpanded star. Webb even detected carbon monoxide gas from the wreckage, proving orbital decay destroyed the world.
